footnotes.text: Cocoa and chocolate products also contain the caffeine-related stimulant theobromine. Cocoa has 228–284 mg./6 oz. cup; chocolate has 480 mg./8 oz. bar.
White chocolate does not contain caffeine—it is a by-product of chocolate.
Dr. Clifford J. Stratton is Doctor of Human Anatomy at the School of Medicine, University of Nevada at Reno. He lives in the Sparks Nevada Stake.
